I found two correctness issues to address during the move: rules are collected in a map, which loses rank order, and distribution lookup skips an exact bucket cutoff. I’ll preserve the existing query structure while fixing those behaviors.

The server now delegates to a separate evaluator dependency, and the existing evaluation tests target that dependency. I’m running the storage and server suites now, then I’ll tighten any behavior the tests expose.

item.text:
Implemented the evaluation split. `Server.Evaluate` now delegates to the new `Evaluator` interface and SQL-backed [EvaluatorStorage](/app/storage/evaluator.go); `RuleStore` no longer owns evaluation logic. The evaluator preserves rule rank order, applies typed, case-insensitive constraints, and selects variants with deterministic CRC32 buckets.

I updated the existing mocks and added focused evaluator tests. `go test ./...` and `git diff --check` pass.
